Lucide line icons (lucide.dev), version 1.72.0, from the lucide-static
package: unpkg.com/lucide-static@1.72.0/icons/<name>.svg

No icon file is shipped here. The 28 icons the site uses are written into
static/css/quadconnect.css as data: URLs (section "Icon shapes"), one CSS
custom property each, so a page loads them with the stylesheet and makes
no third-party request. To add one, copy its SVG into that section in the
same form.

Licence: ISC, with the Feather icons it derives from under MIT (LICENSE).
